panels.title: Traces

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS traces FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = ''

panels.description: Root spans (one per request or job run) in the time range.

panels.title: Error spans

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS errors FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND StatusCode = 'Error'

panels.description: Spans an exception passed through, INCLUDING handled ones. A duplicate webhook is rejected by the inbound_events unique index on purpose (the app still answers 200), and that marks its INSERT span as an error. Check the errors column in Slowest operations before worrying.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() AS web FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = '' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-web' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() AS worker FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = '' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-worker' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent traces: click a trace_id to open its waterfall below

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.Timestamp AS time, r.ServiceName AS service, r.SpanName AS root_span,
       round(r.Duration / 1e6, 1) AS duration_ms, r.StatusCode AS status,
       p.payment_id AS payment_id, r.TraceId AS trace_id
FROM otel.otel_traces AS r
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT TraceId, any(SpanAttributes['payhub.payment_id']) AS payment_id
  FROM otel.otel_traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['payhub.payment_id'] != ''
  GROUP BY TraceId
) AS p ON p.TraceId = r.TraceId
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.Timestamp) AND r.ParentSpanId = ''
  AND ('${roots}' = 'all' OR r.SpanKind = 'Server')
  AND ('${payment_id}' = '' OR p.payment_id = '${payment_id}')
ORDER BY r.Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT TraceId AS traceID, SpanId AS spanID, ParentSpanId AS parentSpanID,
       ServiceName AS serviceName, SpanName AS operationName,
       multiply(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp), 0.000001) AS startTime,
       multiply(Duration, 0.000001) AS duration,
       arrayMap(key -> map('key', key, 'value', SpanAttributes[key]), mapKeys(SpanAttributes)) AS tags,
       arrayMap(key -> map('key', key, 'value', ResourceAttributes[key]), mapKeys(ResourceAttributes)) AS serviceTags,
       if(StatusCode = 'Error', 2, if(StatusCode = 'Ok', 1, 0)) AS statusCode
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE TraceId = '${trace_id}'
ORDER BY startTime ASC

panels.title: Log lines: this trace (or all, when no trace is picked)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, if(LogAttributes['error'] != '' OR LogAttributes['exception'] != '' OR toInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['status']) >= 500, 'error', 'info') AS level,
       TraceId AS traceID
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ('${trace_id}' != '' AND TraceId = '${trace_id}')
   OR ('${trace_id}' = '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('${payment_id}' = '' OR LogAttributes['payment_id'] = '${payment_id}'))
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT ServiceName AS service, SpanName AS operation, count() AS calls,
       round(quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p50_ms,
       round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms,
       round(max(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS max_ms,
       countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS errors
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind IN ('Server', 'Consumer')
GROUP BY service, operation
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT SpanAttributes['server.address'] AS psp, SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] AS method,
       path(SpanAttributes['url.full']) AS path, SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] AS status,
       count() AS calls,
       round(quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p50_ms,
       round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms,
       round(max(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS max_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ScopeName = 'OpenTelemetry::Instrumentation::Faraday'
  AND SpanAttributes['server.address'] IN ('nordpay', 'kiripay')
GROUP BY psp, method, path, status
ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Payments created (counter; resets when web restarts)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, sum(service_total) AS payments_created FROM (
  SELECT time, ServiceName, max(total) AS service_total FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName, TimeUnix, sum(Value) AS total
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'payhub_payments_created_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    GROUP BY time, ServiceName, TimeUnix
  ) GROUP BY time, ServiceName
) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, max(Value) AS outbound_events_pending FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'payhub_outbound_events_pending' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-web' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, max(Value) AS outbound_events_dead FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'payhub_outbound_events_dead' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-web' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, max(Value) AS unknown_state_payments FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'payhub_unknown_state_payments' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-web' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: API p95, last 10m
panels.description: Alert `payhub-slo-api-p95` (ticket, `for: 10m`): its query, run now. The alert fires when it has been above 300 for 10m. See docs/SLO.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ifNotFinite(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 0) AS value
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'payhub-web' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] LIKE '/v1/%'
  AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE

panels.title: Unknown all hour (1 = yes)
panels.description: Alert `payhub-slo-outcome` (page, `for: 0s`): its query, run now. The alert fires as soon as it is above 0. See docs/SLO.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toFloat64(min(Value) > 0 AND min(TimeUnix) <= now() - INTERVAL 55 MINUTE) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'payhub_unknown_state_payments' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-web'
  AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: Payments in unknown
panels.description: Alert `payhub-stuck-unknown` (page, `for: 15m`): its query, run now. The alert fires when it has been above 0 for 15m. See docs/SLO.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'payhub_unknown_state_payments' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-web'

panels.title: Stuck-payment alerts, 15m
panels.description: Alert `payhub-stuck-alerts` (page, `for: 1m`): its query, run now. The alert fires when it has been above 0 for 1m. See docs/SLO.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(rise) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT c.TimeUnix AS TimeUnix,
         if(isNaN(c.prev),
            if(u.first_up <= c.TimeUnix - INTERVAL 30 SECOND, c.Value, 0),
            if(c.Value >= c.prev, c.Value - c.prev, c.Value)) AS rise
  FROM (
    SELECT ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, TimeUnix, Value,
           lagInFrame(Value, 1, nan) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, mapSort(Attributes), mapSort(ResourceAttributes) ORDER BY TimeUnix
                                           ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'payhub_stuck_payment_alerts_total' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-worker'
      AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  ) AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, min(TimeUnix) AS first_up
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'up' AND ServiceName = 'payhub-worker'
      AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE - INTERVAL 1 DAY
    GROUP BY ServiceName, instance
  ) AS u ON c.ServiceName = u.ServiceName AND c.instance = u.instance
  WHERE c.TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
)

panels.title: Scrape up, last minute
panels.description: Alert `payhub-scrape-down` (page, `for: 5m`): its query, run now. The alert fires when it has been below 1 for 5m. See docs/SLO.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.service AS service, toFloat64(ifNull(u.up, 0)) AS value
FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(['payhub-web', 'payhub-worker']) AS service) AS s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ServiceName, min(Value) AS up
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'up' AND ServiceName IN ('payhub-web', 'payhub-worker')
    AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
  GROUP BY ServiceName
) AS u ON s.service = u.ServiceName

panels.description: Alert `payhub-logs-silent` (page, `for: 1m`): its query, run now. The alert fires when it has been below 1 for 1m. See docs/SLO.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS value
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'payhub%'
  AND TimestampTime >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE

panels.title: Archive upload failures, 1h
panels.description: Alert `payhub-archive-upload-failed` (page, `for: 1m`): its query, run now. The alert fires when it has been above 0 for 1m. See docs/SLO.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(rise) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT c.TimeUnix AS TimeUnix,
         if(isNaN(c.prev),
